citation: André T, Boni C, Navarro M, et al. Improved overall survival with oxaliplatin, fluorouracil, and leucovorin as adjuvant treatment in stage II or III colon cancer in the MOSAIC trial. J Clin Oncol. 2009;27(19):3109-16.
data_source: PubMed abstract (PMID 19451431) + literature search: André 2015 JCO (PMID 26324362, 10-year update) + Teixeira 2010 ASCO abstract (PMID 20458040) + Chibaudel 2024 JCO (PMID 38635929)

stage_subgroups.notes: Primary endpoint. FOLFOX4 vs LV5FU2. 5-yr DFS rates: 73.3% vs 67.4%. 6-yr OS rates: 78.5% vs 76.0%.
Stage III OS HR=0.80 (95%CI 0.65-0.97, P=0.023) from abstract. 10-year update (André 2015, PMID 26324362): Stage III OS HR=0.80 (95%CI not reported in abstract, P=0.016); 10-yr OS 67.1% vs 59.0%.
Abstract states 'No difference in OS was seen in the stage II population.' 10-year update (André 2015): Stage II OS HR=1.00 (P=0.980); 10-yr OS 78.4% vs 79.5%.

From Teixeira 2010 ASCO abstract (PMID 20458040). Median follow-up 6 years. DFS HR=0.72 (95%CI 0.49-1.06), OS HR=0.81 (95%CI 0.52-1.26). Trend favoring FOLFOX4 but not statistically significant. Chibaudel 2024 JCO pooled MOSAIC+C07 confirms OS HR=0.86 (95%CI 0.63-1.18, P=0.349) for high-risk stage II — no significant benefit.
From Teixeira 2010 ASCO abstract. DFS HR=1.39 (numerically worse with FOLFOX4 in low-risk stage II, not significant). Confirms no benefit of oxaliplatin in low-risk stage II.
From André 2015 JCO (PMID 26324362). 10-year OS HR=1.00, P=0.980 — no benefit in stage II at 10 years.
From André 2015 JCO (PMID 26324362). Confirmed OS benefit at 10 years for stage III.

criteria_used_in_mosaic: Fewer than 12 lymph nodes examined (inadequate nodal harvest)
high_risk_stage2_definition.primary_criteria_in_mosaic_subanalysis: T4 and/or LN <12 (used in Teixeira 2010 ASCO subanalysis)
high_risk_stage2_definition.notes: MOSAIC trial itself did not prospectively stratify by high-risk stage II. The T4/LN<12 definition was used in post-hoc subanalyses. Chibaudel 2024 JCO pooled analysis used T4, perforation/obstruction, and LN<12 as the 'old definition' of high-risk stage II. No benefit of oxaliplatin was found regardless of high-risk definition used.

molecular_data_in_mosaic.notes: dMMR was independent prognostic factor (HR=2.02, 95%CI 1.15-3.55, P=0.014 for OS). BRAF mutation not prognostic for OS (P=0.965). These are treatment effect HRs (FOLFOX4 vs LV5FU2) within molecular subgroups.

notes: MOSAIC primary paper (PMID 19451431) does not report stage-specific DFS HRs in abstract — only OS HRs by stage. Stage-specific DFS HRs available in full text (not accessible). High-risk stage II DFS HR=0.72 from Teixeira 2010 ASCO post-hoc analysis. PMC full text (PMC2720979) blocked by reCAPTCHA.
